component: Exchange item test helper naming and parameters

quotes.text: The `prefix` argument indicates the prefix to apply to the folders

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The original helper documents prefix as the naming prefix for two folders and two source items. It does not choose copy versus move; callers pass that operation choice separately as isMove. The accepted refactored copy test still requests a copy-prefixed fixture and then sets isMove=false. This is a scoped distinction between fixture identity and operation behavior, not a naming rule for every test helper. The historical four-element tuple docs describe the original helper; later return-shape changes need their own contract check. No fixture or test ran.
title: Copy-move fixture prefixes name test data while isMove selects the operation
